title: Python: Add test validating DaoManager against rpl_route_state.json vectors
description: Python imports run_route_state_vectors() in test_dao.py but never calls it in a test. Rust has canonical_route_state_vectors_match_production_manager that validates the DaoManager against the shared vectors. Python needs an equivalent test for dual-impl parity.
close_reason: Added test_canonical_route_state_vectors_match_dao_manager to tests/rpl/test_dao.py. Validates DaoManager against shared test/vectors/rpl_route_state.json — parity with Rust's canonical_route_state_vectors_match_production_manager.
